label: Sport Venue
description: Training floors, courts, pools and arenas — athletic settings for portrait, lifestyle and action work.

items.name: boxing-gym
items.text: An old boxing gym, a ring with sagging red ropes under a single low lampshade, heavy bags patched with duct tape and fight posters curling on the brick walls.

items.name: skate-park
items.text: A poured-concrete skate park, coping-scuffed bowls and quarter pipes, wax-darkened ledges and scattered stickers beneath a full-length graffiti mural.

items.name: floodlit-pitch
items.text: A rain-freshened training pitch under stadium floodlights, chalk-white touchlines glowing against dark turf, empty dugouts and low haze around the lamp banks.

items.name: climbing-gym
items.text: A climbing gym wall of angled plywood volumes, color-coded resin holds tracing routes up the overhang, chalk dust hanging in slanted light above the crash pads.

items.name: martial-arts-dojo
items.text: A traditional martial arts dojo, sprung cedar floor polished by decades of bare feet, calligraphy scrolls and racked wooden practice weapons along the wall.

items.name: velodrome
items.text: An indoor velodrome, honey-colored pine boards banking to forty-three degrees, the black measurement line and red sprinters' line sweeping through the curve.

items.name: stadium-tunnel
items.text: A stadium players' tunnel, rubberized floor sloping up toward a rectangle of green pitch and glare, championship years stenciled along the concrete walls.

items.name: competition-pool
items.text: A competition natatorium, lane ropes in team colors stretched across deep-blue water, backstroke flags and a digital timing board glowing above the starting blocks.
